message:
All tests pass now (2 of 2). The fix is a one-liner in `src/vat.js`.

The bug was `Math.floor` in `withVat`. The comment says the result is rounded to the nearest penny, and the test expects `withVat(999)` to be 1199. But 999 × 1.2 = 1198.8, and flooring gave 1198. I changed it to `Math.round`, which matches the comment and the test. I didn't touch the test file.

Not checked: the test suite is small (two cases), and I didn't look at how callers use `withVat` elsewhere, since the repo only contains this one module. Rounding half-pence values such as 0.5 rounds up in JavaScript, which is the usual convention, but worth a glance if your pricing rules differ.

I did not commit the change.
